item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-3f0c138faa77112b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Hamburg Cum-Ex inquiry reported no proof that Scholz influenced officials in favor of MM Warburg, although he denied influence and cited memory lapses during testimony; the bank had been expected to repay more than €90 million in allegedly stolen tax money.","question_ids":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source concerns the 2023 inquiry process and Scholz's conduct as a former Hamburg mayor, with reporting published in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The reported testimony and alleged prior political proximity concern Scholz; the inquiry committee and prosecutorial decisions were institutional actions.","limitations":["The source reports no proof of influence but does not establish whether memory lapses were truthful or intentional.","The underlying conduct largely predates Scholz's 2023 chancellorship."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f0c138faa77112b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"The Hamburg Cum-Ex inquiry's staff reportedly suffered internal conflict and delayed its interim report from spring 2023 to spring 2024; a staff member alleged intimidation and suppression of critical questions, while the labor court ordered a warning against her removed from her personnel file, subject to appeal.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.4","7B.6","7B.7","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The delay and alleged obstruction occurred during 2023, while some court proceedings continued in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The reported management problems concern the Hamburg parliamentary inquiry staff and Bürgerschaftskanzlei, not a documented direct order by Scholz.","limitations":["The article attributes allegations to insiders and court reporting; it does not prove Scholz directed the alleged suppression.","The inquiry was a Hamburg state process rather than a federal chancellery process."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cf667d8a6c4158d","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"On 3 June 2023, Leipzig police attempted for about an hour to accommodate a court-banned far-left protest in the name of freedom of assembly, then dissolved it after attacks with stones, pyrotechnics, and other objects; roughly 300 people were provisionally detained and 23 officers were lightly injured.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The event occurred on 3 June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The operational decisions were made by Leipzig police and courts; no direct Scholz decision is reported.","limitations":["This is a subnational policing event and does not establish federal chancellery responsibility.","The source does not report disciplinary or remedial outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-19786562f216960f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"In a December 2023 ARD-DeutschlandTrend survey of 1,364 eligible voters, only 20% were satisfied with Scholz's work, 27% thought him fit for the chancellorship, 23% considered him a good crisis manager, and 12% found him convincing in communication; 82% were dissatisfied with the coalition government.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The survey was conducted 4–6 December 2023 and published 7 December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measures concern public assessments of Scholz and his coalition government.","limitations":["Public satisfaction is an outcome indicator but does not by itself establish policy quality or causation.","The survey reports perceptions rather than independently verified performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-19786562f216960f","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"After the Federal Constitutional Court invalidated the transfer of €60 billion in unused pandemic funds to the Climate and Transformation Fund, the government was forced to prepare a supplementary 2023 budget and postponed adoption of the regular 2024 budget; 47% of respondents favored spending cuts while 35% favored suspending the debt brake for another emergency.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The constitutional ruling and resulting budget crisis occurred in late 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The fiscal transfer was a federal government decision under Scholz's coalition; the invalidation was by the Federal Constitutional Court.","limitations":["The source does not specify Scholz's personal role in designing or approving the transfer.","Survey preferences are not evidence of the objectively best fiscal response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-31bb22ee12d2dece","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Finance Ministry's monitoring report for the €500 billion Special Fund for Infrastructure and Climate Neutrality described a cross-sector monitoring system with public dashboard, milestones, performance budgeting, and follow-up adjustments; for 2025, it later found €13.3 billion in underspending and that about two-thirds of funded budget items remained in planning.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source reports on 2025 implementation and was published in 2026, outside the 2023 target period.","ruler_attribution":"The monitoring system is attributed to the German federal government and Finance Ministry; direct Scholz-era 2023 implementation is not established.","limitations":["The reported fund and results postdate 2023 and should not be treated as direct evidence of Scholz's 2023 outcomes.","The page does not identify Scholz personally."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3e8f94f658b368e3","start_unit":12,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"In 2023 Germany enacted the 11th amendment to the Competition Act, strengthening sector investigations, benefit skimming, merger notification powers, and remedies up to structural separation; the Federal Cartel Office reported active enforcement, including energy-price-brake reviews, digital-platform cases, merger conditions, and a fully operational competition register with more than 255,000 queries.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.6","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The report covers mid-2022 through May 2023, with the 11th amendment enacted on 6 July 2023 and enforcement continuing during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The legal amendment was enacted by the Bundestag and enforcement was carried out by the independent Federal Cartel Office under the federal legal framework.","limitations":["The source does not establish Scholz's personal authorship or intervention.","It reports institutional activity and powers more than completed market outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-968a424795768596","start_unit":23,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"On 5 July 2023, the Bundestag committee rejected the opposition's request for a federal Cum-Ex inquiry into the Warburg Bank affair and Scholz's role; SPD, Greens, and FDP members opposed it, citing constitutional and federalism concerns, while the opposition argued the coalition had not made its objections concrete and had rejected a narrower proposal.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The committee decision occurred on 5 July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The decision was made by the governing parliamentary coalition; the request specifically concerned Scholz's role as former Hamburg mayor and current chancellor.","limitations":["The report presents competing party arguments and does not independently resolve the constitutional question.","It does not show that Scholz personally directed the committee vote."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4d1b139ee866c3de","start_unit":14,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"Germany adopted its first China strategy in July 2023, describing China as increasingly assertive and supporting stronger Indo-Pacific cooperation, peaceful change in the Taiwan Strait, review of export controls, and possible screening of outbound investment in dual-use technology; Reuters reported that the strategy lacked binding targets and concrete measures to reduce dependencies.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.6","2B.1","2B.7","5B.1","5B.4","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The cabinet approved and published the strategy in July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The strategy was approved by Scholz's cabinet after coalition negotiations; the article reports Scholz's narrower view of the government's role in de-risking.","limitations":["The source is a Reuters account of the strategy and does not provide the full primary text.","Implementation outcomes were not yet demonstrated."]},{"source_id":"SRC-48b9a49b3da13c71","start_unit":4,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that Germany's 2022 rights conditions included rising politically motivated and right-wing crimes, gaps in police anti-racism training and independent complaint bodies, a fatal police shooting of a 16-year-old asylum seeker under investigation, expanded universal-jurisdiction prosecutions, limited eligibility for some Ukraine refugees, a ban on several Nakba protests upheld by courts, and climate measures judged insufficient despite stated emissions targets.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.6","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","6B.3","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report covers events in 2022 and was published as World Report 2023; it is contextual evidence rather than a direct 2023 event record.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern German federal, state, police, judicial, migration, and climate institutions; Scholz is directly mentioned regarding criticism of his delayed condemnation of Abbas's Holocaust comparison and China policy.","limitations":["Most facts predate 2023 and therefore provide inherited conditions rather than period outcomes.","The report does not establish personal responsibility for subnational police actions or all institutional shortcomings."]},{"source_id":"SRC-79b88ba25aa6d72e","start_unit":4,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported for 2023 that far-right demonstrations and attacks on minorities increased; Germany extended temporary protection for more than one million Ukrainians but had implementation problems in an Afghan admission program, adopted a draft self-determination law, amended police law to require receipts for stops, enacted the Supply Chain Act, maintained restrictive welfare and asylum conditions, and faced criticism over protest bans, climate policy, arms transfers, and human-rights accountability in foreign policy.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.6","3B.3","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","5B.4","5B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report covers events during calendar year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The reported measures were undertaken by the federal government, ministries, Bundestag, and subnational authorities under Scholz's coalition; some foreign-policy decisions are directly associated with Scholz or his cabinet.","limitations":["The report aggregates national and subnational actions and does not assign each result to Scholz personally.","Several findings concern implementation or institutional conditions rather than a single decision by the chancellor."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-5ef20b853bbead79","SRC-382ec159f50dc6e4"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus includes several documents about 2022, 2024–2026, or institutional pages rather than direct 2023 Scholz events.","No scoring or overall judgment is provided."]}
